snippet.title: Roots of Fury Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In this action-packed RPG, you play as a brilliant but eccentric scientist who shrinks herself to battle an invasion of mutated insects threatening the roots of her plants. With the help of an ant hive, you’ll build your base, craft weapons from bug parts, and fight your way through biology-inspired enemies in a world of origami-inspired art.


🔬 Collect bug body parts through combat
🛠️ Craft unique weapons from insect remains
🐜 Unite with the ants and expand your hive base
🧬 Face off against mutated, biology-inspired enemies
📜 Experience a unique origami-inspired art style

The plants have evolved… but so have the insects. It’s time to shrink down and bring the fight to them!


#RootsofFury #IndieGame #RPG #ActionRPG
